Name: Six months of Elegant Rose Bouquets, July - December
Natural: Our splendid cut flowers are top-quality, long-lasting, and sent fresh from our growers' farms within days of harvest. Each bouquet is hand-selected (our choice of varieties), and carefully arranged prior to shipping. Some flowers arrive in bud stage, maximizing your days of bloom. They are absolutely guaranteed to last 7 days. We ship one bouquet of 12 stems of Roses each month. Bouquets may feature a single solid color, a bicolor Rose, or a mix of colors. Each series includes one glass vase sent with your first shipment. Subsequent deliveries do not include vases. Name: Vibrant Asiatic Lily Bouquet
Natural: The beauty of a summer garden comes indoors! With the help of a specialty grower who raises over 75 varieties of non-fragrant Asiatic Lilies here in the Northeast, we offer cut flowers that are the freshest and longest lasting available anywhere. Our grower will assemble this bouquet when you place your order, creating a stunning arrangement in her choice of colors, ranging from burgundy, red, pink, white, cream to pale green, and yellow. Each bouquet includes 6 stems, 28" long, holding up to 6 buds each. Lilies are grown in the USA.
